Commentary.Commentary: The visitors now have to come back again in an attempt to avoid an innings defeat. They trail by 365 runs and they would hope to bat better this time around, produce a fight and let the Indian bowlers earn their wickets. India on the other hand, will try and replicate what they did in the first hour of this session. Will the evening session be the last one of the game or will the Afghans show some character? Join us after TEA to find out.

INDIA HAVE ENFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON! A dominating display by the bat has been followed up by a clinical performance with the ball. Trailing by a mammoth 474, Afghanistan lost Shahzad courtesy a brilliant run out from Pandya. They never recovered since then as Ishant Sharma and Umesh Yadav ran through the top order. It was then the Ashwin show who finished with a four-fer. Jadeja too finished with 2 wickets to his name. Nabi was the top scorer for Afghanistan with 24. That just shows how dismal they were with the bat.

OUT! One shot too many by Mujeeb! No fifer for Ashwin as Jadeja finishes things off. He bowls it quicker and on middle, Rahman comes down the track and swings but misses. The keeper collects the ball and takes the bails off. AFGHANISTAN ARE ALL OUT FOR 109!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Rahman once again connects with the reverse sweep through short third man.
FOUR! Reverse sweep and it has been played well. Over the point fielder for a boundary.
SIX! Flatter and on middle, Rahman slaps it over the long on fence for a maximum.
The batsman works it down the leg side.

Tremendous effort by Yadav almost gives Ashwin a fifer. Ashwin tosses the ball above the batsman's eye line. Wafadar swings but gets and hits it high up in the air towards long on. Umesh Yadav runs back, dives, gets two hands to it but fails to hang on. The batsmen take two.
FOUR! Another floated ball on middle, Wafadar goes for the slog sweep. The ball goes off the inner half and through square leg for a boundary.
Brings out the reverse sweep and just about clears the man at short third man for a run.
Wafadar is the last man in.

OUT! In the air... taken! A good catch in the end by ishant gives Ashwin his fourth. Once again Ashwin tosses it up, Nabi tries to clear the mid-wicket fence but is done in by the bounce. The ball takes the top edge. it goes up in the air towards square leg. Ishant comes running in from the deep. Also Vijay is running towards the ball from short leg. The former gets to it first and takes a good catch inches above the ground. Afghanistan are nine down now and the end is nigh.
The carom ball on off, Nabi does well to defend it.
Loopy ball on off, kept out.
Survives the second also not in convincing manner though. This is fired on off, Rahman gets into an awkward position but does manage to keep the ball out.
Negotiates one as he defends it off the front foot.
Eases this through covers and takes the single. Mujeeb has 2 balls to play out.
Floats it up on off, Nabi strokes it to the man at covers.
Darts it on off, defended.
Fires it on middle, Nabi keeps it out.
Fires it outside off, Mujeeb first thinks of playing at it but then lets it be.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman strides out to the middle.

OUT! Three-fer for Ashwin. The batsman's patience runs out. Ravichandran once again floats it up on off, it is the carom ball. Yamin's eyes lit up seeing the flight. He makes the mistake of going across the line. The ball takes the outside edge and lobs towards point. Jadeja there accepts a dolly.
Fires it on the stumps, the batsman is solid in defense.
On the stumps, kept out.
Slower through the air outside off, Yamin lunges and tries to defend but is beaten.
Sweeps it to the man at deep square leg. Nabi calls for two but only gets one.
Just short! Darts it on middle, Yamin lunges to defend. The ball hits the higher portion of the bat and lobs towards short leg. Who dives ahead but the ball falls short of him.
Shorter in length, Nabi punches it through cover-point for a run.
Once again, with the angle flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tucks it to the man at mid-wicket with the angle.
Fires it on off, defended.
Paddle sweep and it is played fine on the leg side. Two taken.
Flighted ball on off, kept out.

NOT OUT! The batsman is well in! Nabi guides it towards point. There is hesitation between the two batsman whether to go for the run. They finally go for it. Jadeja at point picks the ball up and fires it to the keeper who collects and whips the bails off. The players appeal and umpire takes it upstairs. One replay was enough for the umpire to rule it in the favor of the batsman.
An appeal for a run out at the striker's end has been taken upstairs. Yamin is the man in question. The Indians do not seem confident though.
Loopy ball again on middle, enticing the batsman to go after him. Nabi resists the temptation and defends it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Intentions are clear here from Nabi, he is going after Ashwin. The bowler gives it air, Nabi uses his feet, gets to the pitch of it and powers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Changes the angle and comes around the wicket. He bowls it on the pads, Nabi works it through mid-wicket but opts against the run.
Full on the stumps, defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A touch shorter on off, Yamin blocks it.
Yamin Ahmadzai is the next man in.

OUT! Jadeja comes and Jadeja strikes. Not the best of deliveries though. It is short and outside off, gets it to bounce a touch extra. Rashid goes for the cut but the ball gets big on him. He fails to keep it down and it goes towards backward point where Yadav moves to his right and takes it.
A loosener to start with, slow and on the shorter side outside off. Nabi cuts it to covers.
A loosener to start with, slow and on the shorter side outside off. Nabi cuts it to covers.
Ravindra Jadeja is into the attack.
Gives it air on middle, Nabi drives it back towards the bowler. He misfields but does not concede a run.
Fires it on middle, Ashwin defends it onto the ground.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Uses his feet and strokes it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and outside off, this one goes on with the arm. Rashid plays for the turn but the ball does not. He gets beaten.
Loopy ball on middle, it is driven to mid-wicket.
Down the leg side and the batsman leaves it.
Wide outside off, Nabi lets it be.

FOUR! Sloppy work in the field! This is fuller on the pads, Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket. Rahul in the deep runs to his left with pads on. He dives, collects the ball but as he stands up, the ball slips out and touches the ropes.
FOUR! Up and over! Full ball on off, that is in Nabi's zone. He lofts it over the mid off fielder and it races away to the fence.
Goes wide of the crease and angles this one into the batsman. Nabi keeps it out.
Good length on off, Nabi mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
This is tucked nicely with the turn through fine leg for a brace.
FOUR! Never easy to hit a cover drive to the offie but Rashid has done it really well here. Ashwin tosses it up outside off, Rashid goes against the turn and slams it through covers for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter on middle, Rashid defends it off the back foot.
Flighted ball on off, Rashid this time is solid in defense.
Very slow through the air on off, it turns back in. Rashid is forward in an attempt to defend but misses to get hit on the body.
On a length around off, Nabi defends it onto the ground.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Length on off, defended.
FOUR! A half volley and the line is very straight. Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bouncer! The batsman evades it.

Good length around off, Nabi is unsure whether to play at it or leave it. He tries pulling his bat out of the way at the very last moment but it takes the bottom edge and goes to the keeper on the bounce.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Loopy ball on off, kept out.
Rashid Khan is the new man in.

OUT! The review does not save him this time! It is PLUMB! Once again it is the flatter one on off, it comes in with the angle and also skids off the surface, Shahidi makes the mistake of going back as he is beaten by the skid of the delivery. The ball sneaks through even before the bat is down and hits the him on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Shahidi signals for the 'T'. Replays roll in and they show that there is no bat involved. The ball has brushed the front pad first and then hit the back pad. Hawk Eye shows the impact to be in line and the wickets to be hitting. Ashwin gets his second and Afghanistan lose a review.
Shahidi is give out once again. Will the review save him another time? It looks quite adjacent.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Flatter and on middle, Shahidi goes back to defend. The ball skids through and the batsman at the very last moment gets his bat down. Ashwin appeals because he feels it has hit pad first but the umpire does not agree.
FOUR! A little too full and the bowler pays the price! Flighted ball on the fuller side. The spin is out of contention. The batsman gets to the pitch of it and times it through covers for a boundary.
Another bouncer, this is a well-directed one. Nabi again ducks under it.
A bumper but it is a little wayward. Down the leg side. Nabi ducks under it.
A yorker on off, Shahidi jams it out towards point and gets to the other end.
On the fuller side, Shahidi times it well but finds the fielder at mid off.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Fuller in length on middle, played to mid on.
Brings out the paddle sweep and plays it fine down the leg side for a brace.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT! Excellent use of the review! This is the straighter one by Ashwin on middle, it comes in with the arm. Shahidi lunges forward and tries to defend but he seems to have missed it and the ball hits the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. The batsman goes for the review immediately and replays show why. There is an inside edge and the decision has to be overturned. Shahidi survives to fight another day.
Shahidi has been adjudged LBW. He goes for the review straightaway. He might have got an inside edge there. That is the only thing that can save him.
On the shorter side, Shahidi cuts it to the man at point.
Flighted ball on off, kept out.
Floats it up nicely on off, the batsman stretches out and blocks it.
End of a tight over by Hardik. He hits the area behind a length on off, Nabi goes back and keeps it out.
Fuller but the line is outside off, Nabi shuffles across and makes a leave.
Hits the length again on off, Nabi defends it to the man at point.
Goes a touch shorter in length on off, Nabi guides it to the man at gully.
On a length around off, this one comes back in slightly. Nabi lunges and keeps it out.
Some issue with the ball. The umpires are having a look at it. They though feel it is fine and then throw it back to the bowler.
Goes fuller on off, Shahidi strokes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Comes forward and blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Mohammad Nabi is the new man in.

DRINKS BREAK. Well, what can be described in this manic period? 5 wickets lost in 75 balls. Afghanistan simply have not shown any gumption to hang in out there. India have been probing but they have not had to do exceedingly well.

OUT! BOWLED! That is a lovely delivery from the offie. He tosses this up over the eyeline of the batsman and entices him forward. Stanikzai comes forward but now he sees the ball has not come yet. That is because Ashwin has lessened the pace as well. That causes hesitation in Stanikzai's footwork and he is indecisive. Eventually, when he does spot the ball, it is dipping into him. He looks to defend but it is half-hearted. The cherry lands, goes past his half lunge, spins in and hits the top of leg stump. Top delivery. ASHWIN NOW GOES PAST ZAHEER KHAN in the list of India's top wicket takers in Tests - 4th as of now, with his 312th scalp.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Spin time. Ravichandran Ashwin to bowl.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
One more leave outside off.
Outside off, quietly left alone.
FOUR! A freebie, on the pads, Shahidi flicks it towards square leg and gets a boundary!
Outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Hardik Pandya time. Has already affected a run out.
Another forward block to end the over.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Outside off, punched through the covers. Jadeja sprints like a hare behind it, gets to the ball, then picks it up, slides and throws in one motion! Too good. Two runs taken.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! On middle and leg, Stanikzai flicks it through square leg. Umesh Yadav runs to his left and slides but while pushing the ball away, his knee touches the ropes.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! Full and on middle, this also threatened to sneak through, but Stanikzai managed to flick it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Captain Asghar Stanikzai walks out. Can he stop the procession?

OUT! Another one goes. Full and outside off, nipping back in, Zazai looks to drive but is comprehensively beaten. There is a massive gap between bat and pad and the ball goes right through. This is turning out to be a no-contest.
Outside off, quietly left alone.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Outside off, left alone.
Hashmatullah Shahidi walks in now.
OUT! Dead plumb LBW. This is straight, Rahmat plays all around it and simply misses the ball. Is hit right in front of the sticks and is adjudged LBW.
Excellent yorker first up, dug out back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, Shah drives it through the covers. Three runs taken.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Rahmat looks to drive but the ball nips back in, takes the inside edge and rockets past the off stump to the fine leg fence.
On a length outside off, comes back in, Rahmat looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad. A strong appeal from the bowler and fielders. The umpire shows no interest in the appeal.
Outside off, left alone.
A bouncer, Zazai ducks under it.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Similar shot, this time Ashwin manages to get to the ball and saves a couple.
FOUR! Full on middle, worked wide of Ravichandran Ashwin at mid on and gets a boundary.
Outside off, left alone.
Afzar Zazai is in early, at number 4. Remember, he kept wickets in the first innings. Should he have come so soon?

OUT! Timber! Right through his defense. Superb bowling. On a length outside off, Ahmadi looks to defend but the bat does not come down at all. It takes an age to come down, as if to indicate he is not in total agreement to play that. There is a massive gap between bat and pad and the ball comes in, goes right through that gap and knocks the off pole. Two wickets down in quick time.
Outside off, Ahmadi pushes at it but then withdraws his bat.
One more leave outside off.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. Spirited effort by the fielder to save runs for his team. Two runs added to the total.
FOUR! Down the leg side, clipped fine for a boundary.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Rahmat Shah walks in at number 3, replacing Shahzad.

OUT! Bull's eye from Hardik sends Shahzad back! Magical fielding. On a length outside off, Shahzad pushes it towards point and sets off running. Hardik quickly gets to the ball, bends, picks the ball with one hand and fires a missile. Destroys the stumps at the bowler's end. It is taken upstairs and replays show that poor Shahzad tried hard to run fast but just couldn't beat Hardik's throw.
Direct Hit! Is Shahzad gone? Referred upstairs...
This one comes in a long way, Shahzad looks to work it to the leg side but misses.
On middle and off, defended towards mid on.
Tighter, just around off, MS hops and blocks it towards short mid-wicket.
Full and straight, Mohammad is squared up but manages to defend.

FOUR! Now that is some shot. Ishant looks for inswing and bowls this one too straight. Shahzad brings his strong wrists and bottom hand into play and whips it powerfully through square leg for a boundary. The deficit is now 459.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
One more leave outside off.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
On a length outside off, Shahzad is squared up as he looks to defend. The ball runs off the outside edge and lands just in front of gully.
Outside off, left alone.
Excellent stop! Ishant sprays this down the leg side but JA misses his flick. The ball goes further down but superman Karthik flies to his left to stop it.
Full and swinging down, Javed misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The ball lobs in the air and Ishant is interested for the caught and bowled but cannot get to it.
Outside off, pushed towards sweeper cover awkwardly for a single.
Outside off, Shahzad pushes but misses.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, Ahmadi gets a proper stride forward and defends.
Ishant Sharma to bowl from the other end.
The batsman goes after a wide one but misses. Interesting opening over.
FOUR! Off the inside edge this time! Full and outside off, Shahzad pushes at it meekly and the ball comes in. Takes the inside edge and goes past the off stump to the fine leg fence!
Down the leg side, MS misses his flick.

EDGED, FOUR! Full and outside off, Shahzad throws his bat at it like there is no tomorrow, does not move his feet and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies past gully and races to the third man fence.
Full and outside off, Mohammad defends it watchfully. Nice outswing on that one.
On a length outside off, pretty wide to start, Shahzaf lets it go.
